question: docs/RECONSTRUCTION-AUDIT.md records two Fees rows with call conflicts and docs/RECONSTRUCTION-STATUS.md records that selected Fees retains two call-conflicting rows. Which windows are they, and does static call-graph analysis resolve them?

duplicate_body_group.note: All four windows hold byte-identical bodies. The body contains no direct, indirect or external calls and no relocations, so its raw hash equals its normalized hash; there is no masked field in which a difference could hide.

799664.basis: Both paired Rent callers reach this window at offset 232 on the original side and reach 787152 at offset 232 on the candidate side. The window is the original .text terminal window; the exclusion that hid it is a strict-index rule, not an evidence gap.

799392.basis: Both paired Rent callers reach this window at offsets 304/312 on the original side and reach 789432 at the same offsets on the candidate side. Body evidence alone lists both candidate copies; the call edges select this one.

conflict_rows.resolution: The only unresolved edge is the offset-232 call to original window 799664. Admitting 799664 under the terminal supplemental pairing (799664 to candidate 787152, __gedf2) makes every direct call in the window consistent with the candidate counterpart. No other edge is unresolved.
Same single edge: the offset-232 call to original window 799664, resolved by the same terminal supplemental pairing. No other edge is unresolved.

bounds: Correspondence is stated at the inventory's own standard: equal size, equal normalized body, equal relocation pattern, and every direct call consistent. Transitive closure and referenced-data equivalence remain unproven for these rows, as they are for the 463 normalized_call_consistent rows.

The within-group assignment rests on encoded call edges because the bodies are identical; this is the attribution method of research/fees-call-target-attribution, applied to a group whose caller set is closed (whole-.text scan: no other call site reaches any of the four windows).
No build, execution, or selection change is proposed. Status promotion of the two rows is the maintainers' step; this package supplies the missing attribution.

prior_conflict_already_closed.note: The pass-01 conflict-refinement.json retains a third record, for original window 700488 under the pass-01 candidate. In the current inventory that window is mapped_pattern: candidate 686080 (spl_associated_token_account create_associated_token_account), raw and normalized equal, calls consistent. It is not one of the two current conflicts and is not reopened here.
